cards.name: The Fool
cards.meaning_up: Folly, mania, extravagance, intoxication, delirium, frenzy, bewrayment.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.meaning_up: Skill, diplomacy, address, subtlety; sickness, pain, loss, disaster, snares of enemies; self-confidence, will; the Querent, if male.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.meaning_up: Secrets, mystery, the future as yet unrevealed; the woman who interests the Querent, if male; the Querent herself, if female; silence, tenacity; mystery, wisdom, science.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.meaning_up: Fruitfulness, action, initiative, length of days; the unknown, clandestine; also difficulty, doubt, ignorance.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.meaning_up: Stability, power, protection, realization; a great person; aid, reason, conviction; also authority and will.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.meaning_up: Marriage, alliance, captivity, servitude; by another account, mercy and goodness; inspiration; the man to whom the Querent has recourse.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.meaning_up: Attraction, love, beauty, trials overcome.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.meaning_up: Succour, providence also war, triumph, presumption, vengeance, trouble.

cards.name: Fortitude
cards.meaning_up: Power, energy, action, courage, magnanimity; also complete success and honours.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.meaning_up: Prudence, circumspection; also and especially treason, dissimulation, roguery, corruption.

cards.name: Wheel Of Fortune
cards.meaning_up: Destiny, fortune, success, elevation, luck, felicity.

cards.name: Justice
cards.meaning_up: Equity, rightness, probity, executive; triumph of the deserving side in law.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.meaning_up: Wisdom, circumspection, discernment, trials, sacrifice, intuition, divination, prophecy.

cards.name: Death
cards.meaning_up: End, mortality, destruction, corruption also, for a man, the loss of a benefactor for a woman, many contrarieties; for a maid, failure of marriage projects.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.meaning_up: Economy, moderation, frugality, management, accommodation.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.meaning_up: Ravage, violence, vehemence, extraordinary efforts, force, fatality; that which is predestined but is not for this reason evil.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.meaning_up: Misery, distress, indigence, adversity, calamity, disgrace, deception, ruin. It is a card in particular of unforeseen catastrophe.

cards.name: The Star
cards.meaning_up: Loss, theft, privation, abandonment; another reading says-hope and bright prospects.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.meaning_up: Hidden enemies, danger, calumny, darkness, terror, deception, occult forces, error.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.meaning_up: Material happiness, fortunate marriage, contentment.

cards.name: The Last Judgment
cards.meaning_up: Change of position, renewal, outcome.

cards.name: The World
cards.meaning_up: Assured success, recompense, voyage, route, emigration, flight, change of place.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.meaning_up: House of the true heart, joy, content, abode, nourishment, abundance, fertility; Holy Table, felicity hereof.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.meaning_up: Love, passion, friendship, affinity, union, concord, sympathy, the interrelation of the sexes, and--as a suggestion apart from all offices of divination--that desire which is not in Nature, but by which Nature is sanctified.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.meaning_up: The conclusion of any matter in plenty, perfection and merriment; happy issue, victory, fulfilment, solace, healing.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.meaning_up: Weariness, disgust, aversion, imaginary vexations, as if the wine of this world had caused satiety only.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.meaning_up: A dark, cloaked figure, looking sideways at three prone cups two others stand upright behind him.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.meaning_up: A card of the past and of memories, looking back, as--for example--on childhood; happiness, enjoyment, but coming rather from the past; things that have vanished.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.meaning_up: Fairy favours, images of reflection, sentiment, imagination, things seen in the glass of contemplation.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.meaning_up: The card speaks for itself on the surface, but other readings are entirely antithetical--giving joy, mildness, timidity, honour, modesty.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.meaning_up: Concord, contentment, physical bien-être; also victory, success, advantage.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.meaning_up: Contentment, repose of the entire heart; the perfection of that state; also perfection of human love and friendship.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.meaning_up: Fair young man, one impelled to render service and with whom the Querent will be connected.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.meaning_up: Arrival, approach--sometimes that of a messenger; advances, proposition, demeanour, invitation, incitement.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.meaning_up: Good, fair woman; honest, devoted woman, who will do service to the Querent.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.meaning_up: Fair man, man of business, law, or divinity; responsible, disposed to oblige the Querent.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Triumph, the excessive degree in everything, conquest, triumph of force.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Conformity and the equipoise which it suggests, courage, friendship, concord in a state of arms.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Removal, absence, delay, division, rupture, dispersion.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Vigilance, retreat, solitude, hermit's repose, exile, tomb and coffin.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Degradation, destruction, revocation, infamy, dishonour, loss.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Journey by water, route, way, envoy, commissionary, expedient.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Design, attempt, wish, hope, confidence; also quarrelling.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Bad news, violent chagrin, crisis, censure, power in trammels, conflict.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Death, failure, miscarriage, delay, deception, disappointment, despair.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Pain, affliction, tears, sadness, desolation.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Authority, overseeing, secret service, vigilance, spying, examination.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Skill, bravery, capacity, defence, address, enmity, wrath, war.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Widowhood, female sadness and embarrassment, absence, sterility, mourning.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.meaning_up: Power, command, authority, militant intelligence, law.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Creation, invention, enterprise, beginning, source.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Riches, fortune, magnificence.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Established strength, enterprise, effort, trade, commerce, discovery.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Country life, haven of refuge, repose, concord, harmony, prosperity, peace.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Competition, struggle, search after riches and fortune.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Victory, triumph, expectation crowned with desire.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Valour, courage against opposition.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Activity, swiftness, speed, movement, arrows of love.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Strength in opposition.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Oppression, fortune, gain, success, burden.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Dark young man, faithful, lover, envoy, postman.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Departure, absence, flight, emigration, change of residence.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Dark woman, friendly, chaste, loving, honourable.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.meaning_up: Dark man, friendly, countryman, honest and conscientious.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Perfect contentment, felicity, ecstasy; speedy intelligence; gold.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Gaiety, recreation, news and messages in writing, obstacles, agitation.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Métier, trade, skilled labour, nobility, glory.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Surety of possessions, inheritance, legacy.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Material trouble, destitution, poverty.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Presents, gifts, gratification, prosperity.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Money, business, barter.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Work, employment, craftsmanship, skill in business.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Prudence, safety, success, accomplishment, discernment.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Gain, riches, family matters, inheritance.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Application, study, scholarship, reflection.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Utility, service, responsibility, rectitude.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Opulence, generosity, magnificence, security, liberty.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.meaning_up: Business aptitude, realizing intelligence, success.
